---
title: '01_preprocessing'
---

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(rio)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
library(eurostat)
library(giscoR)
library(openxlsx)

rm(list = ls())

options(scipen = 999)

```

# load data
```{r}

data_overview <- import("data/data_lfs/data_lfs_overview.xlsx")

data_overview <- data_overview |> filter(year %in% c(2000:2024))

registerDoParallel(parallel::detectCores() - 1)

data_lfs <- foreach(i = data_overview$path, .combine = rbind) %dopar% {
  
  file <- rio::import(paste0(i))

  file <- file |>
    dplyr::select(COUNTRY, REGION_2D, YEAR, AGE, AGE_GRP, SEX, ILOSTAT, MAINSTAT, EMPSTAT, YEARPR, WANTWORK, WANTREAS, SEEKWORK, SEEKREAS, AVAILBLE, AVAIREAS, LEAVREAS, HWUSUAL, COEFFY, COEFFHH, COEFFMOD) |>
    dplyr::filter(AGE_GRP %in% c("Y50-54", "Y55-59", "Y60-64", "Y65-69", "Y70-74")) |>
    dplyr::filter(YEAR %in% c(2000:2024))
  
  return(file)
  
}

stopImplicitCluster()

rm(data_overview)

```

# create LFS variables
```{r}

data_lfs <- data_lfs |>
  mutate(country_code = COUNTRY) |>
  select(-c("COUNTRY"))

data_lfs <- data_lfs |>
  mutate(region_original = factor(paste0(country_code, REGION_2D))) |>
  select(-c("REGION_2D"))

data_lfs <- data_lfs |>
  mutate(year = YEAR) |>
  select(-c("YEAR"))

data_lfs <- data_lfs |>
  mutate(year_binned = case_when(
    year %in% c(2000:2004) ~ "2000-04",
    year %in% c(2005:2009) ~ "2005-09",
    year %in% c(2010:2014) ~ "2010-14",
    year %in% c(2015:2019) ~ "2015-19",
    year %in% c(2020:2024) ~ "2020-24"))

data_lfs <- data_lfs |>
  mutate(age = AGE) |>
  select(-c("AGE"))

data_lfs <- data_lfs |>
  mutate(age_bin = AGE_GRP) |>
  select(-c("AGE_GRP"))

data_lfs <- data_lfs |>
  mutate(sex = case_when(
    SEX %in% c(1) ~ "male",
    SEX %in% c(2) ~ "female")) |>
  select(-c("SEX"))

data_lfs <- data_lfs |>
  mutate(lm_status = case_when(
    EMPSTAT %in% c(1) ~ "employed",
    EMPSTAT %in% c(2) ~ "not employed",
    T ~ NA)) |>
  select(-c("EMPSTAT"))

data_lfs <- data_lfs |>
  mutate(
    working_hours = case_when(
      lm_status %in% c("employed") & !HWUSUAL %in% c(99, 97) ~ HWUSUAL,
      T ~ NA),
    working_hours_norm = pmin(working_hours / 40, 1)) |>
  select(-c("HWUSUAL"))

data_lfs <- data_lfs |>
  mutate(weight = case_when(
    !is.na(COEFFY) ~ COEFFY,
    is.na(COEFFY) & !is.na(COEFFHH) ~ COEFFHH,
    is.na(COEFFY) & is.na(COEFFHH) & !is.na(COEFFMOD) ~ COEFFMOD,
    T ~ NA)) |>
  select(-c("COEFFY", "COEFFHH", "COEFFMOD"))

# select variables and arrange
data_lfs <- data_lfs |>
  select(country_code, year, year_binned, region_original, age, age_bin, sex, lm_status, working_hours, working_hours_norm, weight) |>
  arrange(country_code, region_original, year, age)

```

# clean region codes
```{r}
nuts_harmonised <- import("data/final_nuts_harmonisation.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1")

nuts_harmonised <- nuts_harmonised |>
  mutate(
    region_nuts1 = ifelse(level == "nuts1", region, substr(region, 1, 3)),
    region_nuts2 = ifelse(level == "nuts2", region, NA)) |>
  select(region_original, region, region_nuts1, region_nuts2) |>
  unique()

data_lfs <- data_lfs |> left_join(nuts_harmonised, by = "region_original")

```

```{r}
# regions combining several NUTS units
merged_regions <- c("NO08_NO09_NO0A", "PT16_PT18", "FI1B_FI1C")

# region names (NUTS 2021)
nuts_names <- get_eurostat_geospatial(year = 2021) |>
  select(NUTS_ID, NAME_LATN) |>
  rename("region" = "NUTS_ID", "region_name" = "NAME_LATN")

data_lfs <- data_lfs |> left_join(nuts_names, by = "region")

data_lfs <- data_lfs |>
  mutate(
    region_nuts1 = ifelse(region %in% merged_regions, NA_character_, as.character(region_nuts1)),
    region_nuts2 = ifelse(region %in% merged_regions, NA_character_, as.character(region_nuts2)),
    region_name = case_when(
      region == "NO08_NO09_NO0A" ~ "Combined Oslo, Agder, and Vestlandet",
      region == "PT16_PT18"      ~ "Combined Centro and Alentejo",
      region == "FI1B_FI1C"      ~ "Combined Helsinki and South Finland",
      .default = str_to_title(as.character(region_name))),
    region          = factor(region),
    region_name     = factor(region_name),
    region_original = factor(region_original))

stopifnot(!any(is.na(data_lfs$region_name)))

```

# sample selection
```{r}
data_lfs <- data_lfs |> mutate(year_binned_region = interaction(region, year_binned, drop = TRUE))

# region-sex-period combinations with at least one observation with non-zero weight
data_include <- data_lfs |>
  filter(weight != 0) |>
  select(year_binned, region, sex) |>
  unique()

data_lfs <- data_lfs |>
  # filter out region-sex combinations that do not match inclusion criteria
  semi_join(data_include, by = c("region", "sex", "year_binned")) |>
  # filter rows with missing values
   mutate(
    age_bracket = ifelse(is.na(age), age_bin, age),
    missing = case_when(
      if_any(c("country_name", "region", "age_bracket", "year_binned", "sex", "lm_status", "weight"), ~is.na(.)) ~ 1,
      lm_status == "employed" & is.na(working_hours) ~ 1,
      T ~ 0))

data_lfs <- data_lfs |> 
  filter(!region %in% c("NO0", "NO00", "IS", "IS0",
                        "FRY1", "FRY2", "FRY3", "FRY4", "FRY5", 
                        "ES6", "ES7", "ES70", "ES63", "ES64",
                        "PT2", "PT3", "PT20", "PT30")) |>
  # select variables and arrange rows
  select(country_name, country_code_2d, country_code_3d, region, region_name, region_original, region_nuts1, region_nuts2, year, year_binned, year_binned_region, age, age_bin, age_bracket, sex, lm_status, working_hours, working_hours_norm, weight, missing) |>
  arrange(country_name, region_nuts1, year, age_bracket)

# share of observations with missing values
share_missing <- mean(data_lfs$missing) * 100
share_missing

```

```{r}
data_lfs <- data_lfs |> filter(missing == 0) |> select(-missing)

rm(list = setdiff(ls(), c("data_lfs")))

```

# Tab. B1: sample statistics
```{r}
dir.create("outputs/tables", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

tab_b1 <- data_lfs |>
  filter(!region %in% c("FI1B", "FI1C", "IE04", "IE05", "IE06", "BG3", "BG4", "HU11", "HU12")) |>
  group_by(country_name) |>
  summarise(n_regions = n_distinct(region), n_obs = n(), .groups = "drop")

write.xlsx(tab_b1, "outputs/tables/tab_b1_sample.xlsx")

```
